OpCapability Shader
OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
OpEntryPoint Vertex %main "main"
OpName %main "main"
OpMemberDecorate %structure 0 Offset 0

OpMemberDecorate %structure 2 Offset 32
OpDecorate %structure Block
